implementedContract: Generated and owner-uploaded artwork writes use PostgresArtworkStorage and production composition no longer instantiates FilesystemArtworkStorage.
Canonical private locators are artwork://<issue>/<artifact>; bounded signed same-app URLs expose controlled reads without making raw durable locators public.
Durable reads verify canonical locator, PNG MIME type, byte count and SHA-256 integrity; missing or corrupt records fail closed.
Manufacturing approval reopens the durable object and rejects missing, corrupt or metadata-mismatched artwork before approval.
Release readiness checks the durable artwork relation plus signing/origin safety instead of deployment-local filesystem write/read.
Migration 0036_durable_artwork_objects.sql defines the durable byte authority but remains repository-only and production-unapplied.
remainingLiveEvidence: Before deploying code that requires artwork_objects, obtain explicit production-migration approval for 0036 and run a read-only schema/data preflight.

After approved migration/deployment, create or use a controlled private artwork object and prove the exact bytes survive destructive application restart/redeploy with signed access and integrity checks still working.
CR-15 remains CODE_READY rather than DONE until that deployed destructive recovery proof exists.

activeTask.title: Refund operations and provider-derived reconciliation truth
activeTask.designBoundary: A refund must never become application truth merely because an owner clicked a browser control. The operational path must be provider-derived, auditable and safe for duplicate/replayed provider events. For MVP, either implement a verified provider refund operation through the payment adapter or formally bind an owner runbook to provider-dashboard initiation with automatic provider reconciliation.
requiredEvidence: trace every refund/cancel/reversal write, read, webhook and Owner OS path from payment provider truth into Issue/order lifecycle state
identify whether a first-class refund adapter already exists and whether current UI can create local refund truth without provider proof
create focused TDD RED coverage for the smallest missing operational/refund invariant before behavior changes
preserve idempotency and prevent duplicate/refund replay from creating conflicting commercial truth
preserve customer/privacy boundaries and never log provider secrets or customer private payloads
keep real Safepay charge/refund side effects disabled during code verification unless an explicit owner live-provider gate is reached
verify exact-head unit/typecheck/lint/production build and Browser QA for any Owner OS/customer UI behavior
record any remaining live provider refund proof separately before DONE
